{"code": "# Reuse quickly parse and inspect other group thresholds
import re
rr=[]; current=None
for page in ['page18','page19','page20']:
 o=tables['mmc1.pdf'][page]
 for ri,(row,g) in enumerate(zip(o['rows'],o['geometry']),1):
  if row and row[0]=='Osimertinib' and len(row)>1 and row[1]=='group':current='osi'
  if row and row[0]=='Other' and len(row)>2 and row[2]=='group':current='other'
  if row and row[0]=='Dual' and len(row)>3 and row[3]=='group':current='dual'
  if row and row[0]=='Chemotherapy' and len(row)>1 and row[1]=='group':current='chemo'
  c1=str(row[0]) if row else '';c2=str(row[1]) if len(row)>1 else ''
  m=re.fullmatch(r'(P-\d+)(P-\d+-[A-Z0-9]+)',c1)
  if m:case,org=m.groups()
  elif re.fullmatch(r'P-\d+-[A-Z0-9]+',c2):case,org=c1,c2
  else:continue
  ic=' '.join(c['text'] for c in g['cells'] if 525<=c['x0']<=545)
  resp=' '.join(c['text'] for c in g['cells'] if 560<=c['x0']<=580)
  x=1001 if '(cid:893)' in ic else float(ic)
  rr.append((current,case,org,x,resp))
for th in sorted(set(x for g,*_,x,resp in rr if g=='other')):
 arr=[z for z in rr if z[0]=='other']
 tp=sum(x<=th and resp=='PR' for g,c,o,x,resp in arr)
 fp=sum(x<=th and resp!='PR' for g,c,o,x,resp in arr)
 fn=sum(x>th and resp=='PR' for g,c,o,x,resp in arr)
 tn=sum(x>th and resp!='PR' for g,c,o,x,resp in arr)
 print(th,tp,fp,fn,tn,(tp+tn)/17)
print([z for z in rr if z[0]=='other'])
"}
